company_name: Suzhou Lieqi Intelligent Equipment Co., Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: High — Suzhou Lieqi Intelligent Equipment Co., Ltd. specializes in high-end intelligent equipment for semiconductor manufacturing, particularly in die bonding and packaging.
summary: Suzhou Lieqi Intelligent Equipment Co., Ltd. is a leading manufacturer of high-end intelligent equipment used in semiconductor production. The company focuses on innovative solutions for die bonding, packaging, and testing, serving key industries such as telecommunications and power semiconductors.

regional_presence.China: The company has established R&D centers and production bases in Suzhou and Wuhan.
regional_presence.Thailand: Suzhou Lieqi has a production base in Thailand.
regional_presence.Singapore: The company has a presence in Singapore for its operations.
